question: Which Schedule A assertions are present in the selected complete electronic filing, and which stable report-life transaction IDs were added, modified, removed, or carried forward from its predecessor?

inputs.role: A selected effective document, its immediate predecessor when present, family identity, and immutable selection lineage.
inputs.version_policy: Pin the exact report-family result digest. Any new family observation creates a new projection result.

inputs.role: Every losslessly parsed Schedule A occurrence in the selected document and its predecessor.
inputs.version_policy: Pin document, layout, parser, and occurrence versions. Replay under a new input manifest if any changes.

inputs.role: The ordered 45-field logical Schedule A layout used for semantic row comparison.
inputs.version_policy: Pin the exact layout contract. A field-order or canonical-presence change requires a new digest method and contract version.

identity.result_key: report-family result digest + record family SA + calculation version
identity.input_manifest: Report-family result digest, effective and prior document digests, complete selected Schedule A occurrence manifests, and parser/layout versions.
identity.method_version: contract_version plus the named logical-row and row-set digest methods.
identity.result_digest: SHA-256 of deterministic UTF-8 JSON result bytes. Logical-row and row-set digests are separate content identities defined by this contract.

ordered_steps: Require a publishable selected report-family result. If family selection is blocked, emit blocked_family and no effective row set.
Read every Schedule A occurrence from the selected document as one complete row set. Never overlay the selected amendment onto rows from its predecessor.

Validate every selected Schedule A row and require one non-empty transaction_id that is unique within the complete selected document. Preserve failures as unresolved source evidence but block the effective projection; never construct a fallback key from contributor, date, amount, ordinal, or row bytes.
Construct row_key as report_family_id + ':SA:' + the exact transaction_id. The row form type is content and may change without changing row identity.

Calculate logical-row SHA-256 over exactly 45 ordered source fields. Start with UTF-8 bytes fec.schedule_a.logical_row.v1 followed by one zero byte. For each field append one zero byte when the logical field is omitted/null; otherwise append one byte, a four-byte unsigned big-endian byte length, and the exact accepted decoded field text encoded as UTF-8. Empty text is present with length zero. Exclude framing, terminators, ordinals, parent identity, and extra fields.

Match current and predecessor rows only by row_key. Emit added for current-only, removed for predecessor-only, modified when both logical digests differ, representation_changed when logical digests agree but physical-row digests differ, and carried_forward_identical when both logical and physical row digests agree.

Calculate the semantic row-set digest by starting with UTF-8 bytes fec.schedule_a.logical_row_set.v1 followed by one zero byte, then for each row sorted bytewise by UTF-8 row_key append its four-byte unsigned big-endian key length, key bytes, and raw 32-byte logical digest.

Emit lineage_changed when the selected source occurrence set or document changes. Emit semantic_changed only when the semantic row-set digest changes. Derive downstream keys solely from added, modified, and removed logical rows.

decision_states.meaning: The selected document defines one complete effective Schedule A row set with stable unique transaction IDs.
No effective filing was selected for the report family.
More than one selected occurrence claims the same report-life Schedule A transaction ID.
At least one selected Schedule A occurrence has no usable report-life transaction ID.
At least one selected Schedule A occurrence failed a blocking byte, layout, or record-type check.

invariants: An electronic amendment is a complete report replacement, not a patch. Absence from the selected document means removed from this effective as-filed view.
Original, amendment, and repeated row occurrences remain immutable evidence even when a logical row version is reused.
A carried-forward row belongs to the current filing occurrence. Equal content permits logical-fact reuse but never reassigns source lineage to the predecessor.
Physical framing and semantic content have separate digests so harmless representation changes do not trigger monetary or graph recomputation.
Changed contribution_aggregate, memo, occupation, form type, or any other one of the 45 fields is a semantic modification even when contribution_amount is unchanged.
This calculation selects row presence and versions only. It does not decide memo counting, conduit attribution, entity identity, terminal source, or graph edge meaning.

output.grain: One immutable complete Schedule A projection per selected report-family result and calculation version, with one state per current or removed report-life transaction ID.

publication_states.meaning: The row set can feed separately versioned counting, reconciliation, and graph calculations.
Preserve family evidence but expose no current raw Schedule A view.
Expose duplicate evidence and require resolution; never pick an occurrence.
Expose missing-key evidence and require resolution; never invent identity.
Expose exact invalid rows and issues; publish no complete projection.

revisions.input_change_policy: A changed family result, document, parser, layout, or occurrence manifest creates a new immutable projection. The prior result remains replayable.
revisions.method_change_policy: Any change to row identity, digest framing, comparison states, or blocking behavior requires a new contract and digest-method version.
revisions.history_policy: Retain every physical occurrence, logical digest, effective row set, change state, and result input manifest indefinitely. Removal changes only effective presence.

checks.rule: The input family result is publishable and names exactly one accepted effective document.
Every Schedule A occurrence in the selected document is accounted for exactly once; no predecessor row is copied into the current set.
Every selected Schedule A occurrence has a non-empty transaction ID accepted by the source contract.
No transaction ID occurs more than once within the selected document's Schedule A row set.

current count equals added plus modified plus representation_changed plus carried_forward_identical; prior count equals removed plus modified plus representation_changed plus carried_forward_identical.
Every logical digest and both row-set digests reproduce from pinned source occurrences and the named digest method.
Each modified row lists exactly the differing logical fields in 45-field layout order; carried and representation-only rows list none.
Every current row points to the selected document and every prior or removed row points to its predecessor; source occurrence digests and ordinals resolve.
Preserved extra empty fields may produce a source issue but do not enter the logical digest; any extra non-empty field remains blocked by the source contract.

scenarios: 23 prior and 25 current Schedule A rows
2 added, 5 modified, 0 removed, and 18 carried-forward rows
identical memo row keeps distinct source occurrences
changed accumulator, occupation capitalization, and source-empty district fields
semantic change set targets one committee and 2026 period

propagation.no_change_policy: Always retain the new family and occurrence lineage. If the semantic row-set digest is unchanged, publish the lineage-only result and skip monetary, reconciliation-content, entity, and graph recomputation. If it changed, recompute only keys derived from added, modified, and removed rows; carried-forward identical and representation-only rows update provenance without expensive domain recomputation.

use.retention: Retain complete current and removed row states, content digests, source occurrence locators, and input manifests for every observation-boundary result.
use.disclaimer: This is a provisional as-filed electronic Schedule A view. It excludes paper filings and later FEC processing and does not itself state which rows count toward a total or represent terminal economic sources.
